prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Trend correlations are essentially zero across all models (weak trend tracking), while seasonality correlations vary significantly with ONLY_CWT_catboost leading at 0.9763. CWT_catboost achieves the lowest overall RMSE (70.0976) but differs from the seasonality champion, and early/late horizon specialists also differ (ONLY_CWT_catboost vs CWT_catboost). The high rmse_spread_ratio (74.39) and high seasonality variance indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking optimal to exploit the additive decomposition structure while handling the split between trend and seasonality strengths.
